summary: This bill amends the Federal Food, Drug, and Cosmetic Act to include gluten-containing grains (wheat, rye, and barley) in the definition of a major food allergen, requiring their labeling on food products 18 months after the bill's enactment.

scores.thoughts: This bill amends the Federal Food, Drug, and Cosmetic Act to include gluten-containing grains as a major food allergen, which directly impacts public health and safety by requiring clearer labeling for individuals with celiac disease or gluten sensitivities. This is a moderate, clear impact on healthcare by improving food safety and consumer information.
